_doc: Deterministic fast paths (intents.go). Patterns are full-match, case-insensitive, run on the request with accents, trailing punctuation and polite words removed. {{test}} {{build}} {{lint}} {{fmt}} come from project detection, {{git}} is 'git' inside a repository, {{search}} is rg or grep; an empty variable means the intent does not apply. {{slot}} is a named group, checked against slots[slot] and shell-quoted. Override in ~/.config/jazz-cli/intents.json or .jazz/intents.json (same name replaces, "disabled": true removes).

(?:testa|testar|testa ai|testa tudo|testar tudo|test everything|test it)
